why: Billy has just joined the Cajón Bonita, the main trail south, and talks with a man at three ruined houses beside it before riding on toward the Cabellera.
Riding south along the Cajón Bonita into the mountains, he meets a mule train and two women on the trail. The Cabellera passes come later in the episode.
The next morning, still on the trail south, five armed riders stop him and ask about the wolf. The snow on the Cabellera passes is described only after they ride on.
